results.name: booking_status_card_or_list_not_both
results.description: Sprint 3 Day 5 §14.3 dispatch (Booking Status — viewing existing bookings). §14.3 mutual-exclusion semantics — singular query 'what's my next appointment?' MUST fire render_booking_card AND MUST NOT fire render_bookings_list in the same turn. Catches the failure mode where Haiku emits BOTH terminal render tools in one batch (forbidden — they're mutually exclusive terminal renders for singular vs plural answers). Similar surface to case #2 but the load-bearing assertion is the negative — render_bookings_list MUST NOT appear. Caveat: this duplicates case 2's positive assertion intentionally to give us repeat statistical signal on the singular-card path while isolating the mutual-exclusion guarantee in tools_not_called.
